title: DoH Query Volume by Upstream
app: OpenWrt, UniFi, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, Tailscale, Cloudflare Tunnel, DNS over HTTPS resolvers, and scheduled probes via syslog, APIs, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=doh:query
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as queries, avg(response_ms) as avg_response_ms by upstream _time
| sort - queries
description: Uses DNS-over-HTTPS queries telemetry to monitor daily encrypted query volume and latency by upstream in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for how much each resolver is carrying and how fast it feels, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest DNS-over-HTTPS queries data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Daily upstream chart of DoH volume and latency.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors daily encrypted query volume and latency by upstream so you can spot how much each resolver is carrying and how fast it feels before it becomes annoying.
